title: Tips on Cartwise Shopper Batches — Pass-Through, Tip Changes and Finality
content:
The batch type's tip share (as scheduled for each batch type of Cartwise Shopper Batches) of every customer tip goes to the shopper, and tips are never part of the minimum batch pay or of the pay shown on the offer.

## How tips reach the batch

- **At completion.** The tip on each delivered order is posted when the batch completes, one tip entry per order.
- **Tip changes.** A customer's tip change made within the order's tip edit window (set by the terms of Cartwise Grocery Orders) is passed on as a tip increase or a tip reduction on the batch that completed that order.
- **Floor on a reduction.** A reduction may take the batch's earnings for that order's tip down to 0.00, but never lower.
- **Finality.** Pay and tips become final the batch type's finality hours after completion, when the batch is finalized; after that no tip change reaches the batch.
- **No reversal.** Tips are never reversed by a clawback.

## Which batches a tip change can reach

Tip changes reach only a batch that is completed and not yet finalized, as shown by the batch's status in the system record.

| Batch status | Does a customer's tip change reach the batch? |
|---|---|
| Completed | Yes |
| Finalized | No |

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical)

- An order carried a 6.00 tip, posted to the shopper at completion. The customer lowers it to 2.00 within the tip edit window while the batch is still completed: a tip reduction of 4.00 is taken from the batch's earnings for that order.
- The same order's customer instead lowers the tip by 9.00: the batch's earnings for that order's tip can go down to 0.00 and no lower, so no more than 6.00 is taken.
- A tip increase arriving after the batch has been finalized does not reach the batch.
